hints.title: Password Structural Constraints
hints.text: A strong password satisfies length bounds, contains distinct character categories, and avoids three consecutive identical characters.

hints.title: Three Length Regimes
hints.text: Split by length: under 6 chars requires insertion; between 6 and 20 requires character changes or substitutions; over 20 requires deletions first.

hints.title: Greedy Repeat Reduction with Modulo Offsets
hints.text: When length exceeds 20, use deletions to break triples efficiently. Deleting 1 character from length modulo 3 == 0 saves a replacement. Deleting 2 characters from length modulo 3 == 1 saves a replacement. Allocate remaining deletions to modulo 3 == 2.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Single pass scanning repeats and greedy arithmetic adjustments.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth-first search over all possible password edits expands exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting run lengths modulo 3 resolves deletions in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle three length categories and prioritize deletions by modulo 3.
